title: Let's have fun together!
objectives: use love / like / enjoy + -ing in social contexts

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Let's have fun together!.
Welcome to today's lesson: Let's have fun together!! Today we will practice how to express group leisure preferences.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for Let's have fun together!:
express group leisure preferences; use love / like / enjoy + -ing in social contexts

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: music, cinema, football, gaming, fun, together

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: Complete: 'We enjoy ___ to the cinema together.'

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: We love gaming and listening to music together at weekends. Let's have fun!

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Let's have fun together! We enjoy going to the cinema and playing football. Music brings us together.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Plan a fun weekend activity with your group members.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: express group leisure preferences, use love / like / enjoy + -ing in social contexts.
